tools.name: fixture_export
tools.description: Save a capture into [module/]src/test/resources/dt-fixtures/<name>: per-DB schema/data/constraints SQL + JSON, Kafka JSONL/schema/offsets, hashed manifest and loading instructions. Existing fixtures are preserved unless overwrite=true. Generated resources can be committed with tests.

tools.name: scenario_export
tools.description: Export complete state, action and expectation contracts as separately hashed JSON test resources in [module/]src/test/resources/dt-fixtures/<name>. Arrange them with mocks/containers, apply actions to the actual service, and assert the independently bound effects. Use fixture_export too for replayable PG SQL/Kafka files.

tools.name: fixture_capture
tools.description: Capture one reproducible scenario with bounded, parameterized, read-only reads. Input is fixture_plan inputs or its returned plan. Captures every Kafka partition window, correlation matches, offsets and provenance. Masks sensitive values consistently by default. Returns capture id + interactive explorer; gaps/truncation prevent a claim of completeness. Never writes to the environment.
